title: Semantics of a Positive Oracle Call
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, with oracle, input bit string $x$, and configuration guard $G$ fixed. Suppose that at control state $l$ the instruction is an oracle call to decider $j$ in whole-input mode, using the single register $r$, and that the oracle answers true on the pairing of $x$ with the binary word for the value of $r$. If the successor configuration at $l_1$ satisfies the termination and acceptance semantics for proposition $P$, and the configuration at $l$ satisfies $G$, then the configuration at $l$ satisfies those same semantics for $P$.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $l$ is the specified whole-input oracle call using register $r$
The oracle returns true on the paired input
The successor configuration at $l_1$ has the stated semantics for $P$
